setup_logging: setup logging with console and file handlers for a named logger at a given output directory and rank
shutdown_logging: shutdown all logger streams and close handlers after training is complete
log_gpu_stats: log an nvidia-smi snapshot to capture GPU configuration details
print_gpu_memory_usage: parse nvidia-smi output and log per-GPU memory usage statistics
cached_log_stream: cache an opened log file stream with 10KB buffering for repeated log writes
